_note: comingSoon: true = the live site shows only /coming-soon (plus legal pages, the signup and payment webhooks). Local dev (npm run dev) always shows the full site. Set to false and push to main to launch.

bundle._note: Multi-buy discount applied by Stripe at checkout when the bag holds minItems or more items. Changing percentOff makes a new Stripe coupon automatically. On printed items 20% roughly halves profit on a 2-item order.
bundle.label: Buy any 2, save 20%
